prompt:
## Objective
Make run_ledger redaction at least as strict as action_policy's secret patterns: today policy flags private_key/auth_header but the ledger redactor does not (action_policy.py:41-45 vs run_ledger.py:25-33), so the ledger can persist exactly what policy would deny.

## Design summary
Pre-decided: prefer a drift-failing consistency test over a shared module - both scripts must remain runnable standalone as single files (stdlib-only, hard constraint), so if sharing patterns requires a cross-script import, use the consistency-test approach instead: a test that iterates every policy secret pattern and asserts a sample matching string comes back redacted from the ledger redactor, failing on any future drift.

## File scope
Include: scripts/action_policy.py, scripts/run_ledger.py, scripts/test_action_policy.sh, scripts/test_run_ledger.sh.
Exclude: new secret patterns beyond parity (propose separately if spotted), payload schema (bei-128 scope), everything else.

## Constraints
HARD: Python stdlib-only; single-file standalone execution preserved for both scripts. No git push or PR creation - local branch/diff only. Work test-first: the parity test fails first, then align patterns. Note: bei-128 runs before this slice and also edits action_policy.py - build on its result. If ambiguous, pause and ask.

## Verification
From the repo root:
1. bash scripts/test_action_policy.sh
2. bash scripts/test_run_ledger.sh (incl. the new parity/drift test, all green)
3. git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
dependencies: Ordering: runs after bei-128-action-policy-schema (both edit action_policy.py; workspace serialization)
All four scoped files present at pinned base (probed)

success_criteria: bash scripts/test_run_ledger.sh exits 0 with the new drift-failing parity test

output_expectations.summary: Pattern alignment chosen (shared source vs consistency test) and why; the parity test.
output_expectations.next_step: ready-for-review handoff; human reviews and opens the PR

allow: Edit the four scoped script/test files
Create/commit on a local work branch (vic/bei-129-*)
ask: Any edit outside the include scope
deny: git push, PR creation, or any remote write
Cross-script imports that break single-file standalone execution

routing.reason: pattern parity plus a drift-failing test
